//: Capability manifest for kpi_strip/1 (the .pa-kpi-strip container) — keen-pure-admin (PureAdmin.Components.KpiStrip.kpi_strip/1). CONTAINER + AUTO-HEADER slice: kpi_strip/1 renders a pa-card SHELL (<div class="pa-card pa-kpi-strip [--no-*] {class}" {@rest}>) with an optional header (title_text/is_live), an auto-generated head-row built from the visible columns, an optional footer (footer_text), and an `inner_block` slot for the rows. The DATA ROWS are a SEPARATE component (kpi_strip_row/1) fed through the slot — the dumper passes slot content as plain text, so the per-row __row/__metric/__now/… element classes are the DEFERRED row sub-slice, not mapped here. no_prev/no_delta/no_target are the three column toggles (no_* bools → pa-kpi-strip--no-*); title/live/footer/no_header toggle structural shell parts.
